name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3437: websocket-client abort() only shuts the socket DIRECTION; shutdown() closes the fd. v3436 leaked one CDP descriptor per timed-out tab. Found by the cross-family eye on the SHIPPED bytes; v3436 could not see it because its stub abort() merely incremented a counter. The assertion now checks the fd is RELEASED, not that a method was called, and a new case pins the REAL exception type (every earlier case raised builtin TimeoutError, which websocket never raises). 2 red-proofs.
